verdict.rationale: Temporal documents a local development service built into the CLI (`temporal server start-dev`) that starts a complete Temporal Service with Web UI on your own machine. It also offers a test server with time-skipping for end-to-end and integration tests with Workers. Together these give an isolated environment that is separate from production. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of production-data isolation or sandbox namespaces in Temporal Cloud, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the testing workflow.
